# API Contracts

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### HTTP endpoints

Abacate Calendário acts as an HTTP/WebDAV client (for CalDAV, CardDAV, ICS feeds, and travel routing APIs) and an Android `ContentResolver` / `Intent` consumer. It exposes no inbound HTTP server.

#### 1. Outbound Travel Routing HTTP APIs (`data/travel/`)

All online routing providers share `@TravelHttp OkHttpClient` (`RoutingHttp.kt` lines 35-40) with an 8-second call/connect/read timeout and `User-Agent: KashCalTasks/1.0 (departure alerts; +https://github.com/eusoumadson/KashCal)`.

| Provider | Method & Path | Auth | Request Shape | Response Shape | Error Cases (`RoutingHttp.kt` lines 60-78) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TomTom (`TomTomRoutingProvider.kt`) | `GET https://api.tomtom.com/routing/1/calculateRoute/{originLat},{originLon}:{destLat},{destLon}/json` | Query param `key={apiKey}` | Query params: `key`, `travelMode` (`car` \| `pedestrian` \| `bus`), `traffic=true`, `routeType=fastest` | JSON object with `routes[0].summary.travelTimeInSeconds` and `trafficDelayInSeconds` | `401`/`403` → `RoutingAuthException` (60m circuit break); `429` → `RoutingRateLimitedException` (15m circuit break); `5xx`/IO/bad JSON → `null` (2 consecutive failures → 15m circuit break). |
| Stadia Maps (`StadiaMapsProvider.kt`) | `POST https://api.stadiamaps.com/route/v1` | Query param `api_key={apiKey}` | Valhalla JSON body (`locations`, `costing`: `auto` \| `pedestrian` \| `bus`, `directions_options`) | JSON object with `trip.summary.time` (seconds) | Same HTTP `401`/`403`, `429`, and `5xx`/IO mapping via `RoutingHttp.execute`. |
| OSM Valhalla Demo (`ValhallaDemoProvider.kt`) | `POST https://valhalla1.openstreetmap.de/route` | None; sends header `X-Client-Id: kashcal-tasks-fork` | Same Valhalla JSON body as Stadia Maps | JSON object with `trip.summary.time` (seconds) | Same HTTP `401`/`403`, `429`, and `5xx`/IO mapping via `RoutingHttp.execute`. |

#### 2. Outbound CalDAV & CardDAV WebDAV Endpoints (`sync/client/`, `sync/carddav/`)

| Protocol Family | Methods | Path / Discovery | Auth | Concurrency & Error Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CalDAV Discovery (`CalDavClient.kt`, `SrvResolverImpl.kt`, `TxtResolverImpl.kt`) | DNS `SRV`/`TXT`, `PROPFIND`, `OPTIONS` | `_caldavs._tcp.<domain>` / `/.well-known/caldav` → `current-user-principal` → `calendar-home-set`, `calendar-user-address-set`, `schedule-outbox-URL` | Basic / Digest / App Password via `AuthInterceptor` (`UnifiedCredentialManager.kt`) | Returns `CalDavResult<T>`; refuses cross-host credential leaks with `CODE_TRANSPORT_REFUSED`. |
| CalDAV Delta & Fetch (`CalDavClient.kt`) | `PROPFIND`, `REPORT`, `GET` | `<calendarHomeUrl>` (`Depth: 1`), `<calendarUrl>` (`sync-collection`, `calendar-query`, `calendar-multiget`) | Basic / Digest | `403`/`410` on `sync-collection` invalidates `syncToken` and falls back to ETag listing (`fetchEtagsInRange` / `fetchAllEtags`). |
| CalDAV Mutations (`CalDavClient.kt`) | `PUT`, `DELETE`, `MOVE`, `POST` | `<calendarUrl>/<uid>.ics` (`text/calendar`), `<outboxUrl>` (RFC 6638 iTIP `METHOD:REQUEST`/`CANCEL`) | Basic / Digest | Create sends `If-None-Match: *`; Update/Delete sends `If-Match: "<etag>"`; Move sends `Overwrite: F`; `412` triggers `ConflictResolver`. |
| CardDAV Sync (`CardDavClient.kt`) | `PROPFIND`, `REPORT`, `GET`, `PUT`, `DELETE` | `/.well-known/carddav` → `addressbook-home-set` → `<addressBookUrl>` (`addressbook-multiget`, `text/vcard`) | Basic / Digest | Returns `ContactUploadResult` / `ContactDeleteResult`; `fetchPhoto` rejects URLs outside the CardDAV registrable domain (`OkHttpCardDavClient.kt` lines 82-97). |

#### 3. Android ContentProvider, SAF Backup, & Intent Contracts (`TasksOrgContract.kt`, `BackupEnvelope.kt`, `AndroidManifest.xml`)

| Surface | Authority / Action | Operations & Parameters | Permissions & Guardrails |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Tasks.org API v0 (`TasksOrgContract.kt`) | `content://org.tasks.api/v0` (`tasks`, `lists`, `places`, `accounts`, `tags`, `task_tags`, `reminders`) | Query params only (`limit=1000`, `offset`, `due_after`, `due_before`, `search`, `task_id`); atomic writes via `ContentResolver.applyBatch("org.tasks.api", ops)` (`TasksOrgBatch.kt`). | `org.tasks.permission.READ_TASKS` and `org.tasks.permission.WRITE_TASKS`; non-null SQL `selection` or `sortOrder` throws `IllegalArgumentException`. |
| Android `CalendarProvider` (`AndroidCalendarProviderRepository.kt`) | `content://com.android.calendar` (`Calendars`, `Events`, `Instances`, `Reminders`) | Queries day/range instances and writes device events via `DeviceEventWriter.kt`. | `android.permission.READ_CALENDAR`, `android.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR`. |
| Inbound Activity Intents (`MainActivity.kt`, `AndroidManifest.xml`) | `ACTION_MAIN` (`APP_CALENDAR`), `ACTION_VIEW` / `ACTION_SEND` (`text/calendar`, `application/ics`, `text/x-vcalendar`, `text/plain`, `webcal://`, `webcals://`), `ACTION_INSERT` / `ACTION_EDIT` (`vnd.android.cursor.dir/event`, `vnd.android.cursor.item/event`) | Opens calendar view, routes shared text via `ShareIntentRouter.kt` (`QuickAdd` or `EventFormSheet`), imports `.ics` stream, or pre-fills ICS subscription dialog. | Exported on `MainActivity`. |
| Settings Backup JSON (`SettingsBackupExporter.kt`, `BackupEnvelope.kt`) | SAF `DocumentTree` / user file export | Serializes allow-listed `ExportablePreferences`, `ForkBackupPreferences` (excluding API keys), `IcsSubscription` DTOs, and custom-colored `Category` DTOs. | Excludes account credentials, routing API keys (`TRAVEL_TOMTOM_API_KEY`, `TRAVEL_STADIA_API_KEY`), and device-local IDs. |

### Message formats

Asynchronous work is coordinated through Room's `pending_operations` queue (`PendingOperation.kt`) and WorkManager `Data` payloads (`SyncScheduler.kt`, `TravelReminderScheduler.kt`, `AutoBackupScheduler.kt`, `CalendarBackupWorker.kt`):

| Work / Queue Name | Producer → Consumer | Payload / Schema | Retry & DLQ / Abandonment Behavior |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pending_operations` table (`PendingOperation.kt`) | `EventWriter` → `CalDavSyncEngine` / `PushStrategy` | Columns: `event_id`, `operation` (`CREATE`, `UPDATE`, `DELETE`, `MOVE`, `ATTENDEE_CANCEL`), `status` (`PENDING`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `FAILED`, `ABANDONED`), `target_url`, `source_calendar_id`, `target_calendar_id`, `move_phase` (`0` \| `1`), `linked_move_id`, `partstat_only`, `partstat_target`. | Exponential backoff `30s * 2^retryCount` (max 5h) up to `maxRetries = 10`. Auto-resets `FAILED` after 24h (`AUTO_RESET_FAILED_MS`). Transitions to terminal `ABANDONED` after 30 days (`OPERATION_LIFETIME_MS`) or 3 unresolved HTTP `412` cycles (`MAX_CONFLICT_SYNC_CYCLES`). |
| `periodic_sync` / `one_shot_sync` / `expedited_sync` (`SyncScheduler.kt`) | `SyncScheduler` → `CalDavSyncWorker` | WorkManager `Data` created by `CalDavSyncWorker.createFullSyncInput(forceFullSync)`, `createCalendarSyncInput(calendarId)`, or `createAccountSyncInput(accountId)`. | Periodic and one-shot requests use `BackoffPolicy.EXPONENTIAL` with `SyncNetworkConstraints` (connected internet-capable network, LAN/VPN allowed). |
| `travel_alarm_{eventId}_{occurrenceStartTs}` (`TravelReminderScheduler.kt`) | `TravelReminderScheduler` → `TravelAlarmWorker` | WorkManager `Data`: `{"event_id": Long, "occurrence_start_ts": Long}` (`TravelAlarmWorker.KEY_EVENT_ID`, `KEY_OCCURRENCE_START_TS`), delayed until `occurrenceStartTs - 3_600_000L`. | Returns `Result.retry()` on unhandled exception (`TravelAlarmWorker.kt` line 196); writes `ScheduledReminder` rows (`TRAVEL_BUFFER`, `TRAVEL_DEPART`) with `travel_note` encoded as `provider=...;trafficDelay=...;rushHour=...;live=...;estimate=...;mode=...`. |
| `AutoBackupWorker` & `CalendarBackupWorker` (`AutoBackupScheduler.kt`, `CalendarBackupReconciler.kt`) | Schedulers → `AutoBackupWorker` / `CalendarBackupWorker` | Periodic and one-shot WorkManager jobs (`CalendarBackupWorker.inputFor(kind)`) reading target SAF tree URIs from `KashCalDataStore` and `CalendarBackupStore` to export JSON settings backups and `.ics` offline calendar backups, pruning files beyond retention limits. | Reconciled on preference change and app start via `AutoBackupScheduler.reconcile()` and `CalendarBackupReconciler.reconcile()`. |
